data.intro_title: Work in Canada Without Job Restrictions
data.intro_description: Whether you're a recent graduate or the spouse of an international student, open work permits offer the flexibility to work for any employer in Canada. At Velox Immigration, we guide you through the process of obtaining or extending your open or post-graduation work permit, helping you stay compliant and career-ready.

data.what_we_offer_intro: At Velox Immigration, we support you with the following:

what_we_offer_items.title: Post-Graduation Work Permits (PGWP)
what_we_offer_items.description: Graduated from a Canadian DLI? You may be eligible for an open work permit valid up to three years. We help you determine eligibility based on your institution and program, ensure timely submission, and prepare supporting documents such as transcripts and completion letters.

what_we_offer_items.title: Spousal Open Work Permits
what_we_offer_items.description: If your spouse or partner is a full-time student or skilled worker in Canada, you may be eligible for an open work permit. We assess your relationship documentation, draft affidavits (if needed), and handle all IRCC forms and communications.

what_we_offer_items.title: Bridging Open Work Permits (BOWP)
what_we_offer_items.description: Already applied for permanent residence and your current work permit is expiring? A BOWP lets you keep working while awaiting a decision. We verify your PR file status and guide you through this transitional process to ensure you don't fall out of status.

data.what_you_need_to_apply:
While document requirements vary by permit type, most applicants will need:

 

- A valid passport
- Proof of eligibility (e.g., graduation letter, relationship documents, or PR file number)
- Digital photo
- Proof of status in Canada (if applying inland)
- Supporting documents such as transcripts, pay stubs, or proof of cohabitation
- Payment of the open work permit fee and processing fee

 

We'll provide a personalized document checklist and guide you step-by-step based on your category.

faq_items.question: How long is a PGWP valid for?
faq_items.answer: It depends on the length of your study program. 8 months to 2 years = same duration. 2+ years = up to 3 years.

faq_items.question: Can I apply for a PGWP from outside Canada?
faq_items.answer: Yes, if you meet all eligibility criteria and studied online during COVID-era policies (check expiry of those exemptions).

faq_items.question: Is my school eligible for a PGWP?
faq_items.answer: Only graduates from eligible Designated Learning Institutions (DLIs) qualify. We'll check your institution's status before applying.

faq_items.question: Can my spouse apply for a work permit if I'm on a PGWP?
faq_items.answer: Yes, if you are working in a TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3 occupation and meet minimum income thresholds.

faq_items.question: Can I work full-time while waiting for my PGWP?
faq_items.answer: If you applied while your study permit was still valid, yes—you can work under maintained status until a decision is made.
